protocol: Master Orchestrator receives the validation report.
Master Orchestrator reviews recommended_adjustments, red_flags, suggested_exclusions, and handoff_notes.
Master Orchestrator produces a new full output version tagged revision_round = 2.
Pattern-Validation-Agent receives only the new full output version for a second pass.
If the second pass is still revise, escalate to human review and stop the automated loop.

escalation_after_second_revise.reason_template: Pattern validation still unresolved after second pass.
